title: Cellular detection of objectwise weak homotopy equivalences
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in a fixed universe. Let $P,Q:\mathrm{sSet}\to\mathrm{sSet}$ be ordinary functors preserving all small colimits and all degreewise injective maps. Let $\eta:P\Rightarrow Q$ be an ordinary natural transformation. Assume $\eta_{\Delta^n}:P(\Delta^n)\to Q(\Delta^n)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence for every integer $n\geq0$. Then $\eta_X:P(X)\to Q(X)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence for every small simplicial set $X$, including $X=\varnothing$.
